events.title: Demo Update
events.summary: Hi everyone,We’ve just updated the demo of Jesus Christ: A Gospel Visual Novel. Here’s what’s new:Controller support: you can play the entire demo with a gamepad. On-screen button prompts switch automatically between keyboard and controller.New Skip button: click once to fast-forward, and click again to stop. Skipping also handles scene transitions more smoothly now.Redesigned Settings menu: a cleaner layout, plus a new Controls tab that lists every keyboard and controller input.Improved Chapter

events.title: Demo Hotfix Update
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who has played the demo!Special thanks to the players who left detailed feedback — most of what's in this update directly addresses the issues you raised.【New Features】◆ Automatic System Language DetectionOn first launch, the game now automatically displays in your system language (English / Traditional Chinese / Simplified Chinese). Previously, English-speaking players would see a Chinese interface with no obvious way to change the language — this has been fully resolved.(
